notes.title: Update #5
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Changelog : [/b][/h1]

[b] * [/b] [b]Added real-time challanges[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950404/286846ed18b70eaf5a32a8cd5d1e9635b9b22fde.png[/img]

[b] * [/b] Random event algorithm has been improved.

[b] * [/b] [b]Comment System has been added. Now you will be able to read the comments you have received after the games you have made if you have internet access.[/b]

[b] * [/b] The economic balance has been improved.

[b] * [/b] Fixed a money bug that occurs when you try to buy modem level 2.

[b] * [/b] If you encounter any problem please create a topic at Discussions. <3

notes.title: Hotfix #8
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Changelog : [/b][/h1]


[b] * [/b] Added a system that saves cargo-boxes. You can find your all boxes in front of your Villa when you enter the game.

[b] * [/b] Door mechanics have been improved.

[b] * [/b] The economic balance has been improved.

[b] * [/b] Atmospheric experience has been improved.

[b] * [/b] Minor localization bugs have been fixed.

[b] * [/b] Fixed a rare bug that causes negative money count.

notes.title: Hotfix #7
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Changelog : [/b][/h1]

* The economic balance has been improved. The coefficients of the technologies have been increased.

* Removed an unnecessary feature that occurs when you pay the water bill

* Minor localization bugs have been fixed.

* Specific computier powers has been improved.

* The information panel at the start of the game has been updated.

* Fixed a timing bug that occurs when the video-tutorial starts.

notes.title: Hotfix #6
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Changelog : [/b][/h1]


* Fixed a rare bug that destroys your save file and blocks TAB Menu, Cradle Board mechanics and etc.

* Footstep sound effects were too loud. Footstep SFX's volume were decreased.

* Added an indicator that indicates you to keep debugging phase long.

notes.title: Hotfix #5
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Changelog : [/b][/h1]


* Fixed a lots of bugs that occurs when you try to research audio technologies.

* Fixed a bug that occurs when you try to research Realistic Wind.

* Fixed a bug that occurs when you try to research Food Packs.

* Fixed a bug that occurs when you try to research Flag Textures.

* Fixed a bug that occurs when you try to research Object Animations.

* Minor localization bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Update #5
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Changelog : [/b][/h1]



[b] * [/b] Copyright infringement system has been added. Now, when you produce games with the names of well-known games, you have to pay copyright infringement penalties.

[b] * [/b] Added new indicators. You can learn how to make better games from your old games now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950404/41d024aa497884457d2871e7ddd74b2524f73ad9.png[/img]

[b] * [/b] You can inflate the market when you publish the same type of game consecutively now.

[b] * [/b] Fixed a bug that let you hit high points with buggy games.

[b] * [/b] Fixed a bug that never let you gain enough fans from the adverts.

[b] * [/b] Fixed a bug that causes to not reduce game production time when you upgrade setups.

[b] * [/b] Solved a problem that occurs when there is no snacks on left in the basket.

[b] * [/b] Economic balance is improved but still in the testing phase.

notes.notes:

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Changelog : [/b][/h1]


* Economic balance is [b]improved[/b].

* Fixed a exit problem that occurs when you open the fridge.

* Now you lose more fans when you create bad games.

* [b]Added [/b] automatic save system. Now the game will be automatically saved right after publishing a game.

* Added a new fence door near the General Store.

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Changelog : [/b][/h1]


* [b]Fixed [/b]a bug that occurs when you choose cleaning at the beginning.

* Visual technology costs were [b]reduced[/b].

* [b]Fixed [/b]a bug that occurs graphical problem in the Villa.

* [b]Fixed [/b]some localization problems.

* [b]Added [/b]to do list for villa. It has only 3 level for now. New levels will be added in future updates.

* [b]Fixed [/b]a rare bug that instantiates scenario panels randomly on your screen.

* Economic balance is [b]improved[/b].

* Now you lose more fans when you create bad games.

* Cargo horn sound has been [b]changed[/b].

* [b]Added [/b]fire sounds to campfire.

notes.title: Update #3
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Changelog : [/b][/h1]



[h2] Added New Game Modes ! [/h2]

[b] [h3]Now, You will be able to choose where you want to start ![/h3][/b]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950404/4d2db0037b3160f8cb3b3c705811d5688ccc95fa.png[/img]


[list]
[*] The economic balance has been improved.

[*] Fixed a bug that occurs when you select strategy theme.

[*] Electricity and water bills in  the villa were reduced. If you don't pay them in the time, you'll be fined.

[*] Now, If you pay the water bill, your water dispenser will be automatically refilled.

[*] Fixed a bug that occurs when theme randomizer picks "Animals" main theme.

[*] Fixed a rare bug that occurs when the main theme randomizer algorithm run.

[*] The fan base growth speed has been reduced.

[*] Fixed a bug that makes you millionaire with a low budget games.

[*] Added a new tutorial to the villa.

[*] The game production speed in the villa has been increased.

[*] Now, you can get hungry and thirsty faster.

[*] Fixed a rare bug that occurs when you eat something.

[*] English voice-over for Normal-Mode tutorial will be added next hotfix.

[/list]

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Changelog : [/b][/h1]


* The number of rents to be paid to move to the villa has been reduced.

* The amount of income required to move to the villa has been reduced.

* The number of main themes that need to be researched to move to the villa has been reduced.

* Upgrade cost of Garage PC has been reduced to 3.000$.

* Environmental money bonuses in the garage have been increased.

* The low-budget games you make in the Villa now let you earn more.

* Fixed a bug that causes minus research points at the Villa.

* Fixed some notification bugs.

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Changelog : [/b][/h1]


[b]* Fixed a bug that occured when you try to close skill board with "e" key.

* Removed an panel that shows you how much you earn & how you developt your skills. You will now earn regular income for a short time after receiving the results of your games in the garage.

* Fixed a bug that cause save problem with researched main themes in the Garage.

* A few labels have been added to the General Store in the Villa.[/b]
